In this video, I build a fully working chainless bicycle drivetrain powered by a series of gears - and all system was 3D printed.

Instead of a normal chain transmission, I designed and tested multiple gears, printed them on a Phrozen 3D printer, and assembled a mechanical gear-driven system that transfers power straight to the rear wheel.

This wasn’t just a “cool model” project - it had to be functional, strong, and accurate enough to survive real riding conditions.
